standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: I’ve got a really bad stomach ache.
Do you think it was something you ate?
entries.zh: 你觉得是吃坏东西了吗？

entries.en: I think I was too hungry.
I didn’t have any lunch at school today.
entries.zh: 我今天在学校没吃午饭。

entries.en: I think you need to just go and lie down for a while.
entries.zh: 我觉得你需要去躺一会儿。

entries.en: I’m sure you’ll feel better soon.
entries.zh: 我相信你很快就会好起来。

entries.en: And don’t worry about the washing-up.
I’m sure your brother will do that.
So how can I help you today?
Hmm, yes, it does look a bit bruised.
Well, it’s a bit of a silly story really.
I got home from school yesterday and I didn’t have my key with me.
entries.zh: 我昨天放学回家时没带钥匙。

entries.en: I left it in my locker at school so I tried to open the door with my elbow.
entries.zh: 我把钥匙落在学校的储物柜里了，所以试着用胳膊肘开门。

entries.en: Well, I don’t think it’s anything too serious.
entries.zh: 嗯，我觉得没什么太严重的问题。

entries.en: You need to put some ice on it, and take some painkillers if it hurts too much.
entries.zh: 你需要用冰敷一下，如果太疼就吃点止痛药。

entries.en: You’re able to move it so I’m not too worried.
entries.zh: 你还能活动它，所以我不太担心。

entries.en: But next time you forget your key, just wait for your parents to get home.
entries.zh: 不过下次忘了带钥匙，就等你父母回家。

entries.en: What can I do for you?
And what’s the problem with it?
I went to bed last night and when I woke up it was really hurting.
entries.zh: 我昨晚睡觉，醒来时它疼得厉害。

entries.en: Did you do any sport yesterday?
But I did sleep with the window open.
entries.zh: 但我确实开着窗户睡觉了。

entries.en: My grandmother thinks the cold air made it hurt but I’m not so sure.
entries.zh: 我奶奶觉得是冷空气让它疼，但我不太确定。

entries.en: No, I don’t think there’s any connection there.
OK, well, let’s have a look at it.
Can you take your shirt off for me, please?
